[[File:EwokHorns-ROTJ.png|thumb|Ewoks playing horns]]
'''Horn''' was a generic term for different types of [[Music/Legends|wind instruments]]. Archaic horns owed their name to the hard outgrowths found in pairs on the heads of certain creatures, in which they were carved. In some cultures, such as the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], horns were made out of [[Mon Calamari Shell Horn|large seashells]]. Other types of horns were made of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] or sheets of [[Metallurgy/Legends|metal]]. Known variants of horns comprized the [[Xloff horn|Xloff]], [[Plandl horn|Plandl]], [[Faln horn|Faln]], [[Woot horn|Woot]], and [[Flagn horn|Flagn]] horns.
